meta.note: Multi-day models on daily closes with real SPXL / TQQQ prices. Each has a random twin: the same trades, held the same number of days, but started on random dates. A model only shows real timing skill if it clearly beats its twin. Buy and hold over this period: SPY +140%, SPXL +522%; QQQ +191%, TQQQ +498%. $100 per trade, $0.005 per share each way

groups.name: RSI(2) swing
groups.desc: Daily RSI(2) under 10 above the 200-day average, buy; sell above the 5-day average or at the time limit

models.rule: Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 3 days
Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 5 days
Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 10 days

groups.name: RSI(2) random twin
groups.desc: Each RSI(2) trade copied with a random start date and the same hold length · real timing vs just being long

models.rule: Random start, same days held as RSI(2) Conservative
Random start, same days held as RSI(2) Moderate
Random start, same days held as RSI(2) Aggressive

groups.name: Turn of the month
groups.desc: Buy 2 trading days before month end, sell on day 1 / 3 / 5 of the new month

models.rule: Sell on trading day 1 of the new month
Sell on trading day 3 of the new month
Sell on trading day 5 of the new month

groups.name: Turn of month random twin
groups.desc: Each turn-of-month trade copied with a random start date and the same hold length · real timing vs just being long

models.rule: Random start, same days held as Turn of the month Conservative
Random start, same days held as Turn of the month Moderate
Random start, same days held as Turn of the month Aggressive
